::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Module:** Item response theory  
**Tranche:** extension (beyond a first course)  
**Before this:** [Factor analysis II: confirmatory models, omega, and IRT as factor analysis](fa-confirmatory.qmd)  
**Builds toward:** none  
**Picks up threads:** Alpha is a lower bound on reliability (from [Classical test theory and reliability](ctt-reliability.qmd)); One factor accounts for the item correlations (from [Factor analysis I: exploring dimensionality](fa-exploratory.qmd)); The data fix the correlations, not the frame of the factors (from [Factor analysis I: exploring dimensionality](fa-exploratory.qmd)); Responses are independent given θ (from [The Rasch model](rasch.qmd)); Model-based reliability (omega) in place of alpha (from [Factor analysis II: confirmatory models, omega, and IRT as factor analysis](fa-confirmatory.qmd)); Ordinal factor analysis is the graded response model (from [Factor analysis II: confirmatory models, omega, and IRT as factor analysis](fa-confirmatory.qmd)); Wording direction can act as a second dimension (from [From construct map to items: building an instrument](instrument-building.qmd))  
**IRW tables:** [`florida_twins_dweck`](https://itemresponsewarehouse.org/tables/florida_twins_dweck/), [`florida_twins_grit`](https://itemresponsewarehouse.org/tables/florida_twins_grit/)
